works.title: Water Lilies
works.alt: Water Lilies. A pond fills the frame.
works.description: A pond fills the frame. Floating leaves interrupt a field of reflected sky; distance is suggested by color rather than a horizon.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Claude Monet, Water Lilies, 1906. Oil on canvas. Art Institute of Chicago. https://api.artic.edu/api/v1/artworks/16568

works.title: Impression, Sunrise
works.alt: Impression, Sunrise. A small orange sun and its reflection hold their place against a harbor of blue-gray strokes.
works.description: A small orange sun and its reflection hold their place against a harbor of blue-gray strokes. Boats arrive as dark, economical silhouettes.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Claude Monet, Impression, Sunrise, 1872. Oil on canvas. Musée Marmottan Monet. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Monet_-_Impression%2C_Sunrise.jpg

works.title: Woman with a Parasol — Madame Monet and Her Son
works.alt: Woman with a Parasol — Madame Monet and Her Son. The viewpoint is low and the sky expansive.
works.description: The viewpoint is low and the sky expansive. Dress, grass, and clouds appear caught in the same movement of air.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Claude Monet, Woman with a Parasol — Madame Monet and Her Son, 1875. Oil on canvas. National Gallery of Art. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claude_Monet_-_Woman_with_a_Parasol_-_Madame_Monet_and_Her_Son_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: Poppy Field
works.alt: Poppy Field. Bright red marks lead the eye through pale grasses.
works.description: Bright red marks lead the eye through pale grasses. The figures are part of the field’s rhythm, not isolated from it.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Claude Monet, Poppy Field, 1873. Oil on canvas. Musée d’Orsay. https://www.musee-orsay.fr/en/artworks/coquelicots-1010

works.title: The Japanese Footbridge
works.alt: The Japanese Footbridge. The bridge draws a firm arc through foliage.
works.description: The bridge draws a firm arc through foliage. Beneath it, floating plants and reflections loosen the distinction between solid and liquid.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Claude Monet, The Japanese Footbridge, 1899. Oil on canvas. National Gallery of Art. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Japanese_Footbridge-Claude_Monet.jpg

works.title: Water Lilies and Japanese Bridge
works.alt: Water Lilies and Japanese Bridge. The garden closes around a footbridge, while the pool opens another space below.
works.description: The garden closes around a footbridge, while the pool opens another space below. Similar greens take on different weights in water and air.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Claude Monet, Water Lilies and Japanese Bridge, 1899. Oil on canvas. Princeton University Art Museum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claude_Monet_-_Water_Lilies_and_Japanese_Bridge_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: Composition VIII
works.alt: Composition VIII. Circles, triangles, arcs, and diagonals share a pale field.
works.description: Circles, triangles, arcs, and diagonals share a pale field. The composition has both the precision of a diagram and the unstable balance of a performance.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Wassily Kandinsky, Composition VIII, 1923. Oil on canvas. Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vassily_Kandinsky%2C_1923_-_Composition_8%2C_huile_sur_toile%2C_140_cm_x_201_cm%2C_Mus%C3%A9e_Guggenheim%2C_New_York.jpg

works.title: Composition VII
works.alt: Composition VII. A dense current of marks resists a single focal point.
works.description: A dense current of marks resists a single focal point. The painting opens through repeated looking: a pale passage, a dark knot, a sudden turn.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Wassily Kandinsky, Composition VII, 1913. Oil on canvas. State Tretyakov Gallery. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vassily_Kandinsky%2C_1913_-_Composition_7.jpg

works.title: Yellow–Red–Blue
works.alt: Yellow–Red–Blue. A yellow structure and a large blue circle pull in different directions.
works.description: A yellow structure and a large blue circle pull in different directions. Lines cross the space between them like another layer of thought.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Wassily Kandinsky, Yellow–Red–Blue, 1925. Oil on canvas. Centre Pompidou. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kandinsky_-_Jaune_Rouge_Bleu.jpg

works.title: Several Circles
works.alt: Several Circles. Translucent discs overlap against a dark ground.
works.description: Translucent discs overlap against a dark ground. Color becomes luminous at their edges, suggesting depth without a conventional setting.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Wassily Kandinsky, Several Circles, 1926. Oil on canvas. Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vassily_Kandinsky%2C_1926_-_Several_Circles%2C_Gugg_0910_25.jpg

works.title: Black and Violet
works.alt: Black and Violet. Large dark forms are held in tension by fine lines and small accents.
works.description: Large dark forms are held in tension by fine lines and small accents. The open background is an active part of the arrangement.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Wassily Kandinsky, Black and Violet, 1923. Oil on canvas. See source record. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kandinsky_-_Black_and_Violet%2C_1923.jpg

works.title: Study for Composition VII, No. 2
works.alt: Study for Composition VII, No. 2. An expansive study in which color masses gather, dissolve, and change direction.
works.description: An expansive study in which color masses gather, dissolve, and change direction. Its loose passages make the process of composition visible.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Wassily Kandinsky, Study for Composition VII, No. 2, 1913. Oil on canvas. Lenbachhaus. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wassily_Kandinsky_-_Studie_zu_Komposition_VII_(Entwurf_2)_-_GMS_64_-_Lenbachhaus.jpg

works.title: The Starry Night
works.alt: The Starry Night. The sky occupies most of the canvas.
works.description: The sky occupies most of the canvas. Curves of blue and pale yellow sweep past the upright cypress and the quieter geometry of the village.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night, 1889. Oil on canvas. The Museum of Modern Art. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: Almond Blossom
works.alt: Almond Blossom. Pale blossoms spread across an uninterrupted blue.
works.description: Pale blossoms spread across an uninterrupted blue. The branches make a network that can be followed from one edge of the painting to another.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Vincent van Gogh, Almond Blossom, 1890. Oil on canvas. Van Gogh Museum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_-_Almond_blossom_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: Sunflowers (Munich version)
works.alt: Sunflowers (Munich version). Petals, seeds, and leaves give each flower a different texture.
works.description: Petals, seeds, and leaves give each flower a different texture. The vase gathers them into a still life that remains full of irregular movement.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Vincent van Gogh, Sunflowers (Munich version), 1888. Oil on canvas. Neue Pinakothek. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Van_Gogh_-_Zw%C3%B6lf_Sonnenblumen_in_einer_Vase.jpeg

works.title: Starry Night over the Rhône
works.alt: Starry Night over the Rhône. Points of light stretch into the river.
works.description: Points of light stretch into the river. Above and below the horizon, short yellow strokes turn darkness into a sequence of reflections.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Vincent van Gogh, Starry Night over the Rhône, 1888. Oil on canvas. Musée d’Orsay. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: The Bedroom
works.alt: The Bedroom. The room is built from strongly outlined furniture and tilted planes.
works.description: The room is built from strongly outlined furniture and tilted planes. Empty space around the bed becomes as distinctive as the objects themselves.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Vincent van Gogh, The Bedroom, 1888. Oil on canvas. Van Gogh Museum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_-_De_slaapkamer_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: Wheatfield with Crows
works.alt: Wheatfield with Crows. Paths interrupt the gold of the field while dark birds mark the sky.
works.description: Paths interrupt the gold of the field while dark birds mark the sky. The wide format places the viewer close to an unresolved stretch of land.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Vincent van Gogh, Wheatfield with Crows, 1890. Oil on canvas. Van Gogh Museum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_-_Wheatfield_with_crows_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

works.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa
works.alt: Under the Wave off Kanagawa. The wave curls over the boats, while Mount Fuji sits inside the opening below it.
works.description: The wave curls over the boats, while Mount Fuji sits inside the opening below it. The small distant mountain and the immense foreground wave share a pointed profile.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Katsushika Hokusai, Under the Wave off Kanagawa, c. 1830–1832. Color woodblock print on paper. See impression record. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Katsushika_Hokusai_-_Thirty-Six_Views_of_Mount_Fuji-_The_Great_Wave_Off_the_Coast_of_Kanagawa_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg
works.dimensions: Horizontal ōban; dimensions vary by impression

works.title: Fine Wind, Clear Morning
works.alt: Fine Wind, Clear Morning. The mountain’s red slope meets a blue sky patterned with white clouds.
works.description: The mountain’s red slope meets a blue sky patterned with white clouds. Human activity disappears, leaving large planes of color and the shape of the summit.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Katsushika Hokusai, Fine Wind, Clear Morning, c. 1830–1832. Color woodblock print on paper. Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Katsushika_Hokusai_-_Fine_Wind%2C_Clear_Morning_(Gaif%C5%AB_kaisei)_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg
works.collection: Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields

works.title: Kajikazawa in Kai Province
works.alt: Kajikazawa in Kai Province. Fishing lines extend from a rocky ledge toward moving water.
works.description: Fishing lines extend from a rocky ledge toward moving water. Their triangular arrangement answers the outline of Fuji beyond.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Katsushika Hokusai, Kajikazawa in Kai Province, c. 1830–1832. Color woodblock print on paper. See impression record. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/56727
works.dimensions: Horizontal ōban; dimensions vary by impression

works.title: Ejiri in Suruga Province
works.alt: Ejiri in Suruga Province. Wind lifts papers and bends the trees along a winding path.
works.description: Wind lifts papers and bends the trees along a winding path. Fuji remains still on the horizon, a counterpoint to the foreground’s agitation.
works.rights: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Henry L. Phillips Collection, 1939. Public Domain / Open Access.
works.citation: Katsushika Hokusai, Ejiri in Suruga Province, c. 1830–1832. Color woodblock print on paper. Multiple impressions; see the image record for the reproduced impression. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ejiri_in_the_Suruga_province.jpg
works.dimensions: Horizontal ōban print; dimensions vary by impression
works.collection: Multiple impressions; see the image record for the reproduced impression

works.alt: Mishima Pass in Kai Province. Travelers gather beside a large tree.
works.description: Travelers gather beside a large tree. The close trunk sets a human scale against the layered landscape beyond.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Katsushika Hokusai, Mishima Pass in Kai Province, c. 1830–1832. Color woodblock print on paper. Multiple impressions; see the image record for the reproduced impression. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hokusai29_mishima-pass.jpg
works.dimensions: Horizontal ōban print; dimensions vary by impression
works.collection: Multiple impressions; see the image record for the reproduced impression

works.title: Tsukuda Island in Musashi Province
works.alt: Tsukuda Island in Musashi Province. Boats cross a broad plane of water.
works.description: Boats cross a broad plane of water. The coast and its small buildings form an interval between the nearby vessels and distant Fuji.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Katsushika Hokusai, Tsukuda Island in Musashi Province, c. 1830–1832. Color woodblock print on paper. Multiple impressions; see the image record for the reproduced impression. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hokusai16_tsukuda-island.jpg
works.dimensions: Horizontal ōban print; dimensions vary by impression

works.title: The Thinker
works.alt: The Thinker. A compact seated body carries a dense network of tensions: bent back, resting elbow, compressed limbs.
works.description: A compact seated body carries a dense network of tensions: bent back, resting elbow, compressed limbs. Thought is made visible as physical effort.
works.rights: Auguste Rodin; photograph: Joseph Coscia / The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (CC0 1.0); via Wikimedia Commons.
works.citation: Auguste Rodin, The Thinker, Modeled c. 1880; cast c. 1910. Bronze. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 11.173.9. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/191811

works.title: Eternal Spring
works.alt: Eternal Spring. Two figures make a continuous arrangement of torsos and limbs.
works.description: Two figures make a continuous arrangement of torsos and limbs. The work moves between the independent bodies and the single silhouette they create.
works.rights: Auguste Rodin; photograph: Joseph Coscia / The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (CC0 1.0); via Wikimedia Commons.
works.citation: Auguste Rodin, Eternal Spring, Modeled c. 1881; carved 1907. Marble. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 17.120.184. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/193438

works.title: The Walking Man
works.alt: The Walking Man. Without a head or arms, the figure concentrates attention on the spread of the legs and the weight of the torso.
works.description: Without a head or arms, the figure concentrates attention on the spread of the legs and the weight of the torso. A step becomes the whole subject.
works.rights: Auguste Rodin; reproduction: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (CC0 1.0); via Wikimedia Commons.
works.citation: Auguste Rodin, The Walking Man, Model completed before 1900; cast before 1914. Bronze, green patina. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 40.12.4. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/198565

works.title: The Age of Bronze
works.alt: The Age of Bronze. An upright figure holds its arms in different registers.
works.description: An upright figure holds its arms in different registers. Its stance makes the body seem poised between waking, movement, and stillness.
works.rights: Auguste Rodin; photograph: Joseph Coscia / The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (CC0 1.0); via Wikimedia Commons.
works.citation: Auguste Rodin, The Age of Bronze, Modeled 1876; cast c. 1906. Bronze. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 07.127. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/189265

works.title: Madame X
works.alt: Madame X. A portrait emerges from a broad mass of marble.
works.description: A portrait emerges from a broad mass of marble. Look at the change between the polished face and the less resolved stone surrounding it.
works.rights: Auguste Rodin; reproduction: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (CC0 1.0); via Wikimedia Commons.
works.citation: Auguste Rodin, Madame X, Modeled c. 1907. Marble. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 11.173.6. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/191808

works.title: The Hand of God
works.alt: The Hand of God. A large hand holds a small cluster of figures within the stone.
works.description: A large hand holds a small cluster of figures within the stone. The work sets the scale of the maker against the scale of what is being formed.
works.rights: Auguste Rodin; reproduction: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (CC0 1.0); via Wikimedia Commons.

works.title: The Ten Largest, No. 2, Childhood
works.medium: Tempera on paper mounted on canvas
works.alt: The Ten Largest, No. 2, Childhood. Warm orange forms and delicate lines float against blue.
works.description: Warm orange forms and delicate lines float against blue. The painting invites both close inspection of its small signs and a sense of its enormous scale.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest, No. 2, Childhood, 1907. Tempera on paper mounted on canvas. The Hilma af Klint Foundation. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hilma_af_Klint_-_The_Ten_Largest_No._2_-_Childhood_-_1907.jpg

works.title: The Ten Largest, No. 3, Youth
works.medium: Tempera on paper mounted on canvas
works.alt: The Ten Largest, No. 3, Youth. Large loops and organic shapes press against a richly colored field.
works.description: Large loops and organic shapes press against a richly colored field. Forms seem to open, join, and multiply.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest, No. 3, Youth, 1907. Tempera on paper mounted on canvas. The Hilma af Klint Foundation. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hilma_af_Klint_-_The_Ten_Largest_No._3_-_Youth_-_1907.jpg

works.title: The Ten Largest, No. 4, Youth
works.medium: Tempera on paper mounted on canvas
works.alt: The Ten Largest, No. 4, Youth. A dense constellation of curves and symbols unfolds across an orange ground.
works.description: A dense constellation of curves and symbols unfolds across an orange ground. The whole composition is larger than a single glance can comfortably hold.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest, No. 4, Youth, 1907. Tempera on paper mounted on canvas. The Hilma af Klint Foundation. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hilma_af_Klint_-_The_Ten_Largest_No._4_-_Youth_-_1907.jpg

works.title: The Ten Largest, No. 5, Adulthood
works.medium: Tempera on paper mounted on canvas
works.alt: The Ten Largest, No. 5, Adulthood. Spirals, letters, and petal-like forms share the field.
works.description: Spirals, letters, and petal-like forms share the field. The organization becomes a language of recurring relationships rather than a fixed key.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest, No. 5, Adulthood, 1907. Tempera on paper mounted on canvas. The Hilma af Klint Foundation. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hilma_af_Klint_-_The_Ten_Largest_No._5_-_Adulthood_-_1907.jpg

works.title: The Ten Largest, No. 7, Adulthood
works.medium: Tempera on paper mounted on canvas
works.alt: The Ten Largest, No. 7, Adulthood. Overlapping colored forms establish a patient, expansive rhythm.
works.description: Overlapping colored forms establish a patient, expansive rhythm. Small inscriptions suggest a system without offering a complete explanation.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest, No. 7, Adulthood, 1907. Tempera on paper mounted on canvas. The Hilma af Klint Foundation. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hilma_af_Klint_-_The_Ten_Largest_No._7_-_Adulthood_-_1907.jpg

works.title: The Ten Largest, No. 9, Old Age
works.medium: Tempera on paper mounted on canvas
works.alt: The Ten Largest, No. 9, Old Age. The composition turns toward pale ground and measured forms.
works.description: The composition turns toward pale ground and measured forms. Its quieter intervals remain active: emptiness is part of the structure.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Hilma af Klint, The Ten Largest, No. 9, Old Age, 1907. Tempera on paper mounted on canvas. The Hilma af Klint Foundation. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hilma_af_Klint_-_The_Ten_Largest_No._9_-_1907.jpg

works.title: The Gray Tree
works.alt: The Gray Tree. Branches spread into a shallow gray field.
works.description: Branches spread into a shallow gray field. The tree remains recognizable even as its structure begins to share the logic of the surrounding space.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Piet Mondrian, The Gray Tree, 1911. Oil on canvas. Kunstmuseum Den Haag. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gray_Tree_1911.jpg

works.title: Evening (The Red Tree)
works.alt: Evening (The Red Tree). A red trunk and branching limbs hold their shape against blue.
works.description: A red trunk and branching limbs hold their shape against blue. The tension between color and observed form is already the main event.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Piet Mondrian, Evening (The Red Tree), 1908–1910. Oil on canvas. Kunstmuseum Den Haag. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piet_Mondrian%2C_1908-10%2C_Evening%3B_Red_Tree_(Avond%3B_De_rode_boom)%2C_oil_on_canvas%2C_70_x_99_cm%2C_Gemeentemuseum_Den_Haag.jpg

works.title: Flowering Apple Tree
works.alt: Flowering Apple Tree. The tree dissolves into arcs and faceted planes.
works.description: The tree dissolves into arcs and faceted planes. A pale, restricted palette makes the relation of each line to its neighbors more visible.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Piet Mondrian, Flowering Apple Tree, 1912. Oil on canvas. Kunstmuseum Den Haag. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blossoming_apple_tree%2C_by_Piet_Mondriaan.jpg

works.title: Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow
works.alt: Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow. A large red plane dominates the square while small blue and yellow areas adjust its weight.
works.description: A large red plane dominates the square while small blue and yellow areas adjust its weight. Unequal divisions produce a deliberate equilibrium.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Piet Mondrian, Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow, 1930. Oil on canvas. Kunsthaus Zürich. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piet_Mondriaan%2C_1930_-_Mondrian_Composition_II_in_Red%2C_Blue%2C_and_Yellow.jpg

works.title: Composition with Large Red Plane, Yellow, Black, Gray and Blue
works.alt: Composition with Large Red Plane, Yellow, Black, Gray and Blue. A broad red area is held against several narrower divisions.
works.description: A broad red area is held against several narrower divisions. The black lines vary in their relationship to the edge rather than functioning as a neutral frame.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Piet Mondrian, Composition with Large Red Plane, Yellow, Black, Gray and Blue, 1921. Oil on canvas. Kunstmuseum Den Haag. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piet_Mondriaan%2C_1921_-_Composition_en_rouge%2C_jaune%2C_bleu_et_noir.jpg

works.title: Composition No. III, with Red, Blue, Yellow and Black
works.alt: Composition No. III, with Red, Blue, Yellow and Black. The arrangement makes modest differences of scale consequential.
works.description: The arrangement makes modest differences of scale consequential. White surfaces, black boundaries, and color all participate in the balance.
works.rights: Public-domain artwork; reproduction via Wikimedia Commons. See image record for reuse details.
works.citation: Piet Mondrian, Composition No. III, with Red, Blue, Yellow and Black, 1929. Oil on canvas. Private collection; see the historical catalogue record. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piet_Mondrian_-_Composition_No._III%2C_with_red%2C_blue%2C_yellow_and_black%2C_1929.jpg
works.collection: Private collection; see the historical catalogue record

works.alt: Toward Los Angeles, California. Two men walk along a road beneath a billboard advertising a different kind of travel.
works.description: Two men walk along a road beneath a billboard advertising a different kind of travel. The photograph holds their journey and the commercial promise in the same frame.
works.rights: Dorothea Lange. U.S. federal agency photograph; public domain. Source record linked below.

works.description: Children appear within the setting of a migratory camp. The archive identifies the family through their displacement from Oklahoma; the photograph also asks for attention to each person in the frame.
works.rights: Dorothea Lange. U.S. federal agency photograph; public domain. Source record linked below.
works.citation: Dorothea Lange, Children of an Oklahoma Drought Refugee, California, 1936. Black-and-white photograph. works.alt: Dust Storm near Mills, New Mexico. The view records a dust storm near Mills.

works.rights: Dorothea Lange. U.S. federal agency photograph; public domain. Source record linked below.
